translationRepairs: Boyan soon had his son Dalima put to death and sent Yilianzhenban into exile on Hainan.
Boyan soon had Yilianzhenban's son Dalima put to death and sent Yilianzhenban into exile on Hainan.
Chinese 其子指亦憐真班之子答裡麻（後文列其子九人長答裡麻），英文 his son 誤屬伯顏。
Soon he killed his son Dalima and banished him to Hainan.
Soon he killed Yilianzhenban's son Dalima and banished Yilianzhenban to Hainan.
Literal likewise leaves 其子/謫置 referent ambiguous; source makes Dalima Yilianzhenban's son and exile of Yilianzhenban.
Early in the Taiding reign he was made Zishan Grand Physician and Commissioner of the Court of Imperial Regalia.
Early in the Taiding reign he was made Zishan Grandee and Commissioner of the Court of Imperial Regalia.
資善大夫 is a civil prestige rank (Grandee), not a physician title.
Early in the Zhishun reign he was made Hanlin Academician Expositor-in-Chief and Ronglu Grand Physician, then Commissioner of Meritorious Achievements, retaining his position as commander.
Early in the Zhishun reign he was made Hanlin Academician Expositor-in-Chief and Ronglu Grandee, then Commissioner of Meritorious Achievements, retaining his position as commander.
榮祿大夫 is a prestige rank (Grandee), not a physician title.
He was made Zishan Grand Physician and Vice Censor-in-Chief of the Jiangnan Branch Censorate.
He was made Zishan Grandee and Vice Censor-in-Chief of the Jiangnan Branch Censorate.
資善大夫 is a prestige rank (Grandee), not a physician title.
He was promoted to first rank as Ronglu Grand Physician.
He was promoted to first rank as Ronglu Grandee.
榮祿大夫 is a prestige rank (Grandee), not a physician title.

In the winter of 1363 he was made Garrison Commander of Shangdu and concurrently Prefect of Kaiping, promoted to Ronglu Grand Physician, and charged with overseeing Tuling and garrisoning the three eastern prefectures to supervise grain transport.

In the winter of 1363 he was made Garrison Commander of Shangdu and concurrently Prefect of Kaiping, promoted to Ronglu Grandee, and charged with overseeing Tuling and garrisoning the three eastern prefectures to supervise grain transport.
榮祿大夫 is a prestige rank (Grandee), not a physician title.
Before long Bolu Temür was executed in secret, Tujian Temür and the rest all fled in rout, and Shangdu was secure.
Before long Bolu Temür was put to death, Tujian Temür and the rest all fled in rout, and Shangdu was secure.
伏誅 means execution for crime or treason, not a clandestine killing; 'in secret' invents a sense absent from the Chinese.
